about.title: About Me
about.p1_html: I'm Mehdi Lakhouane, an independent developer based in Frankfurt. I build AI agents, web apps, mobile apps, and games — all focused on solving problems I've encountered firsthand.
about.p2_html: I've created a local AI coding agent that runs fully offline, a Tamazight dictionary PWA preserving my native language, a computer vision tool for construction sites, and multiple shipped games in Godot.
about.p3: I work across the full stack — Python, React, Flutter, Godot, Electron — and I ship what I build. Every project on this site is live or downloadable.

trench.title: From Trench to Tech
trench.connector: My hands-on experience allows me to build software that actually works for people wearing gloves and standing in the mud. I bridge the gap between heavy machinery and high-level code.

process.title: How I Build
process.think_desc: Every project starts with one question: what's broken and who's affected? Whether it's preserving a language or automating safety logs, I map the real-world workflow before writing a single line.
process.build_desc: I focus on "MVP first" — getting the core logic working before polishing. I use comments to structure my thought process and treat documentation as part of the code, not an afterthought.
process.ship_desc: A project on a local drive helps no one. I prioritize deployment and usability, ensuring my tools work on the devices they were meant for, from job site tablets to desktop workstations.

strengths.title: How I Think
strengths.lead: I learned discipline in a trade where one bad measurement means tearing up a road. That same precision drives how I write code.
strengths.s1_desc: I finish what I start. 10+ projects live and working — not sitting in a local folder. If I build it, I deploy it.
strengths.s2_desc: I taught myself Python, AI agents, React, Flutter, and Godot by shipping real projects. No bootcamp. No course certificates. Just working software.
strengths.s3_desc: My tools are built for people who actually need them — field workers, language learners, developers who want privacy. Not hypothetical users.

projects.title: Projects
projects.shadow_desc: A Proactive Sovereign Agent that lives in the system tray. Unlike reactive chatbots, it acts before you ask. Built for a world where your data should never leave your device.
projects.shadow_problem: Cloud AI assistants compromise privacy, leak sensitive data, and cannot perform local OS-level actions.
projects.shadow_solution: A local-first "Sovereign Agent" that runs in the system tray, monitoring context to act proactively without data ever leaving the device.
projects.shadow_tech: Python 3.13, Ollama (Local LLMs), System Tray API, Secure Enclave Architecture.
projects.shadow_impact: Delivers 100% data sovereignty and automates background workflows with zero latency.
projects.mastermind_desc: A production-ready, air-gapped AI core and local coding agent. Eliminates cloud telemetry risks with a Local-First RAG architecture.
projects.mastermind_problem: Cloud-based copilots exfiltrate proprietary code and lack awareness of local OS context or data sovereignty laws.
projects.mastermind_solution: A self-hosted autonomous Python agent ("Sovereign Mastermind") that lives on the machine and acts as a localized second developer.
projects.mastermind_tech: Python 3.13, PyAudio, ChromaDB, Ollama, React 19 (for the marketing OS site).
projects.mastermind_impact: Provides full autonomous coding power and document analysis while eliminating 100% of telemetry risks, logging every action to an immutable audit ledger.
projects.graben_desc: A specialized tool for construction safety and management. Currently in active development, bringing digital precision to trench work.
projects.graben_problem: Trench safety relies on slow paper checklists and manual oversight, leading to delayed hazard responses and regulatory risks.
projects.graben_solution: A digital site supervisor that tracks real-time safety metrics, digitizes logs immediately, and enforces protocol compliance.
projects.graben_impact: Reduces incident reporting time by 90% and ensures auditable safety compliance.
projects.awal_desc: A comprehensive digital dictionary for the Tamazight language (Zaouiat Ahansal dialect). Built as a high-performance PWA that works offline and installs on any device.
projects.awal_problem: The Tamazight language (Middle Atlas dialect) lacks accessible, offline-capable digital resources, risking cultural erosion.
projects.awal_solution: A high-performance Progressive Web App (PWA) with a custom root-based search algorithm available 100% offline.
projects.awal_tech: Vanilla JavaScript, Service Workers (PWA), JSON, CSS3.
projects.awal_impact: Provides instant, offline access to 2000+ roots, preserving cultural heritage on any device.
projects.rebar_desc: A Windows desktop tool that uses Computer Vision to automatically measure spacing from site photos.
projects.rebar_problem: Manual "eyeball" inspections of rebar spacing are prone to human error, leading to failed structural inspections and $10k+ rework costs.
projects.rebar_solution: A Windows desktop tool that uses Computer Vision to automatically measure spacing from site photos and generate PDF reports.
projects.rebar_impact: Detects measurement errors in under 60 seconds, preventing costly concrete rework.
projects.asphalt_desc: A professional asphalt estimation tool built from real construction experience. Calculates area, volume, weight, and logistic requirements.
projects.asphalt_problem: Generic calculators fail to account for asphalt variation (density, compaction loss), causing costly material shortages or waste.
projects.asphalt_solution: A specialized web estimator using industry-standard density formulas to calculate exact tonnage, cost, and logistics.
projects.asphalt_impact: Reduces material waste by ~15% and ensures precise ordering for large-scale road projects.
projects.godot_desc: Built and fully finished multiple game projects, demonstrating complete lifecycle development from concept to polish.
projects.godot_problem: Many game projects fail due to poor architecture, becoming unmaintainable "spaghetti code" as complexity grows.
projects.godot_solution: "Neon Quadrants" — A complete, polished arcade suite built with modular architecture to handle multiple game modes seamlessly.
projects.godot_tech: Godot Engine, GDScript, Finite State Machines, Particle Systems.
projects.godot_learnings: Managing complex game state, implementing "Game Feel" (juice/feedback), and profiling performance for smooth 60FPS.
projects.ai_desc: Exploration of AI logic, behavior, and practical applications using open-source models.
projects.ai_problem: Theoretical knowledge of AI isn't enough; understanding the practical limitations of LLMs requires hands-on testing.
projects.ai_solution: A repository of experiments dissecting model behavior, prompt engineering logic, and API integration patterns.
projects.ai_tech: Python, PyTorch (Basics), OpenAI API, Hugging Face.
projects.ai_learnings: The difference between stochastic generation and deterministic logic, and how to constrain AI outputs for reliable software.

story.title: Behind the Build
story.quote: "I built RebarSight because I saw a contractor break out concrete due to rebar spacing errors. 4 weeks later — it's ready."
story.p: This isn't just code — it's a tool born from watching real money get wasted on a real job site. That's why I build.

datenschutz.h3: 3. Data collected when visiting the website (server logs)
datenschutz.p3: When this website is accessed, technically necessary data (IP address, timestamp, URL accessed, referrer, user agent) is processed by our host. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in secure operation). These logs are stored for a short time for security purposes.
datenschutz.p4: We only store your cookie consent decision in your browser's local storage. This storage is strictly necessary to respect your choice and not show the banner again. No consent is required.
datenschutz.p5_html: Only with your explicit consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR, § 25(1) TTDSG) do we collect anonymous statistics about page views. We use no tracking cookies and share no data with third parties.
datenschutz.p5_li2: referrer (where you came from), if your browser sends it
datenschutz.p5_li3_html: approximate country (derived from the IP by Vercel, without storing the IP)
datenschutz.p5_li5_html: a daily-rotating, salted hash of IP + user agent as session ID. This hash cannot be traced back to your IP and expires after 24 h.
datenschutz.p5_footer_html: The IP address itself is not stored. The data is hosted on Supabase servers in the EU (Ireland).
datenschutz.p6: When you send a message via the contact form, we process the data you provide (name, email, message text) to handle your request. The legal basis is your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), which you give by actively ticking the checkbox. In addition, we store a daily-rotating hash of your IP for spam prevention (rate limiting); this can no longer be attributed after 24 hours. Messages are deleted after a maximum of 12 months, provided no further communication takes place. You can withdraw your consent at any time by sending us an email.
datenschutz.p7_html: The /admin area is only accessible to the site operator. Authentication is via a "magic link" through Supabase Auth. Only the email address and a session token are processed. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.
datenschutz.p8_li1: Reach measurement: aggregated up to 24 months, raw data deleted after 90 days.
datenschutz.p8_li2: Consent log: 3 years (retention obligation under Art. 7(1) GDPR).
